backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for EcoPowerHubAI with access control, user profiles, system configurations, energy data management, AI recommendations, alarms, maintenance, diagnostics, EV integration, Stripe payments, blob storage, and HTTP outcalls.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report JSON file with no features documented.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend React components, pages, and hooks including routing, authentication, dashboard tabs, charts, system management, analytics, and deployment status monitoring.
frontend/.env.pinata.example: Example environment configuration file for Pinata IPFS API credentials (JWT token and gateway domain).
frontend/dist/.ic-assets.json5: IC asset configuration defining cache headers, MIME types, and security policies for static assets, JavaScript, CSS, images, and SPA fallback routing.
frontend/dist/index.html: Production build HTML with comprehensive SEO meta tags, Open Graph, Twitter cards, structured data, PWA manifest, internationalization hreflang tags, and security headers for EcoPowerHub AI.
frontend/docs/build-optimization-notes.m: Documentation of build optimizations including duplicate key fixes, React.lazy code splitting for routes, and Vite manual chunk configuration for vendor libraries.
frontend/docs/pinata-pinning.md: Guide for using Pinata SDK to pin files to IPFS, including prerequisites, environment variable setup, and usage instructions.
frontend/index.html: Development HTML template identical to dist/index.html with full SEO, PWA, and internationalization configuration for EcoPowerHub AI.
frontend/public/.well-known/ic-domains: IC domain verification file listing ecopowerhub.ai and www.ecopowerhub.ai for Internet Computer custom domain configuration.
frontend/public/generated/.gitkeep: Empty placeholder file to preserve the generated assets directory in version control.
frontend/public/generated/GENERATION_GUI: Comprehensive guide specifying visual style, color palette, and detailed requirements for generating 57 PNG assets including logos, setup guides, dashboards, and branding materials for EcoPowerHub AI.
frontend/public/generated/STYLE-GUIDE.tx: Visual style guide defining color palette (blue/green theme), typography, design elements, and technical requirements for consistent asset generation across the EcoPowerHub AI platform.
frontend/public/manifest.json: PWA manifest defining app metadata, icons, shortcuts, and configuration for EcoPowerHub AI as a standalone progressive web application.
frontend/public/robots.txt: Robots.txt file allowing public pages while disallowing dashboard/admin routes, with sitemap reference and crawl-delay directive.
frontend/public/service-worker.js: Service worker implementing network-first strategy for navigation, cache-first for assets, with versioned cache management and offline fallback support.
frontend/public/sitemap.xml: XML sitemap listing all public pages with priorities, change frequencies, and multilingual alternate links for SEO optimization.
frontend/restore-assets.js: Node.js script that verifies presence of all 57 required PNG assets in the generated directory with dimension validation across categories (branding, logos, setup guides, etc.).
frontend/scripts/pinata-fs-utils.mjs: File system utilities providing deterministic file discovery, sorting, and size formatting for consistent IPFS pinning operations.
frontend/scripts/pinata-pin.mjs: CLI script that recursively pins files from a directory to IPFS using Pinata SDK, generating a deterministic manifest mapping file paths to CIDs. Requires PINATA_JWT environment variable and supports optional PINATA_GATEWAY configuration.
frontend/scripts/resend-ecopowerhub-logo: CLI utility that reads the monochrome-dark logo PNG (white on transparent), encodes it to Base64, and outputs a specified slice (1-4) as plain text without formatting for concatenation purposes.
CLI utility that reads the monochrome-white logo PNG (black on transparent), encodes it to Base64, and outputs a specified slice (1-4) as plain text without formatting for concatenation purposes.
CLI utility that reads the full-color emblem logo PNG (1024x1024), encodes it to Base64, and outputs a specified slice (1-4) as plain text without formatting for concatenation purposes.
frontend/scripts/verify-no-deprecated-pi: Verification script that scans frontend and backend directories for deprecated Pinata API calls (pinata.upload.folder, pinata.pinFromFS) and fails the build if any are found.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application component that sets up routing with TanStack Router, query client, theme provider, and authentication flow. Implements lazy loading for non-initial routes and displays profile setup modal for authenticated users without profiles.
frontend/src/components/affiliate/SolarG: Affiliate marketing component showcasing solar generator brands (EcoFlow, Bluetti, Jackery) with detailed specs, app features, commission info, and EcoPowerHub integration details.
frontend/src/components/affiliate/Tracki: Small component that displays an affiliate tracking ID with a copy-to-clipboard button and toast notification feedback.
frontend/src/components/AlarmNotificatio: Displays a modal alarm notification with morning update cards showing weather, energy usage, and efficiency metrics; plays alarm sounds and supports text-to-speech for the update content.
frontend/src/components/AppErrorBoundary: React error boundary component that catches and displays application errors with options to reload the page or navigate home.
frontend/src/components/AraChat.tsx: Floating chat widget component that provides canned support responses from 'Ara, Chief Operations' for common troubleshooting questions.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/AddAla: Dialog component for adding new morning alarm configurations with wake-up time, ringtone, alert beep, language, and active status settings. Submits alarm data to backend via useAddAlarmConfig mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/AddSys: Dialog component for adding new energy system configurations (HVAC, solar, etc.) with region-specific device support, brand selection, and API endpoint setup. Auto-detects user region from browser language and validates supported devices per region.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Alarms: Tab component displaying all configured morning alarms with toggle, edit, and delete functionality. Shows alarm list with formatted times and settings, or empty state prompting users to add their first alarm.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Analyt: Analytics dashboard tab showing energy consumption charts with historical and predicted data, deployment URL with copy functionality, and DNS/SSL status monitoring. Includes downloadable JSON report generation with system and energy data summary.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/EditAl: Dialog component for editing alarm configurations with form inputs for wake-up time, ring tone, alert beep, language, and active status. Uses React Hook Form state and mutation hook to update alarm settings.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Energy: Recharts-based line chart component that visualizes energy consumption and temperature data over time with dual Y-axes. Formats timestamps and displays data from EnergyData array prop.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/EVAuth: Dialog component for connecting Ford or Rivian electric vehicles via OAuth authentication. Handles mock OAuth flow and creates EVOAuthConfig with access tokens for vehicle data integration (battery level, range, charging status).
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Mainte: Dashboard tab displaying system health status, service monitoring, and maintenance metrics. Shows overall system status with color-coded indicators, uptime percentage, and manual refresh capability.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/MyEVCa: Card component displaying EV telemetry data including battery level, range, and charging status for Ford or Rivian vehicles. Includes button to initiate solar charging and disconnect functionality.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Overvi: Main dashboard overview tab showing energy statistics, temperature averages, active systems count, and friendly onboarding messages. Aggregates data from multiple systems and displays stats cards with loading states.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Recomm: Tab displaying AI-powered energy optimization recommendations filtered by user's preferred language. Shows potential savings alert and lists recommendations with system IDs, regions, and timestamps.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/System: Dashboard tab component for managing connected energy systems and EV integrations (Ford/Rivian), with dialogs for adding systems and authenticating EVs.
Grid of cards displaying status for each connected energy system, showing latest energy consumption and temperature data. Handles empty state when no systems are connected.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Temper: Bar chart component displaying temperature data by location with Celsius/Fahrenheit conversion support using Recharts.
frontend/src/components/diagnostics/Smar: AI diagnostics panel displaying automated device health monitoring results with quality badges (good/bad/uncertain) and troubleshooting information.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple footer component displaying copyright, attribution to caffeine.ai, and EcoPowerHub.ai branding.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Application header with logo, user greeting, theme toggle, and logout button; includes responsive mobile navigation via sheet menu.
frontend/src/components/LoadingErrorBoun: Loading and error state wrapper that displays timeout warnings, offline detection, and retry functionality with detailed error messages.
Footer component for the marketing site with brand info, social media links, quick navigation links, and legal links organized in a three-column grid layout.
Sticky header component with logo, navigation menu, region/language selectors, theme toggle, and mobile menu support for the marketing site.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog for initial user profile setup that collects name, preferred language, and auto-detects timezone, with form validation and submission handling.
frontend/src/components/RouteErrorFallba: Error boundary fallback UI component that displays error details and provides options to go home, retry, or reload the page.
frontend/src/components/StableImage.tsx: Image component that prevents flickering during re-renders by maintaining stable dimensions, handling loading states, and providing fallback UI for failed image loads.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook managing the backend actor instance with Internet Identity authentication, automatically invalidating dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context and hook providing Internet Identity authentication with login/logout functionality and identity state management using @dfinity/auth-client.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for fetching and mutating backend data including user profiles, system configs, EV data, diagnostics, and admin checks.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light/dark themes, color schemes (green/eco-focused), and utility classes for grid patterns and stable image loading.
frontend/src/lib/alarmService.ts: Provides alarm and morning update functionality including motivational messages, voice prompts with weather and energy data, alarm sound playback via Web Audio API, and text-to-speech for morning updates.
frontend/src/lib/assetRestoration.ts: Documents all 58 required PNG assets with metadata (filename, dimensions, purpose, usage locations, category) for validation by the vite-build-verify.js script during build.
frontend/src/lib/assetVerification.ts: Provides runtime asset verification utilities with categorized lists of all required generated assets for HTTP HEAD request validation at runtime.
frontend/src/lib/generatedAssetPaths.ts: Centralized constant definitions for all generated PNG asset paths in /generated directory, organized by category (branding, device logos, setup guides, solar products, affiliate cards, etc.).
frontend/src/lib/i18n.ts: Internationalization utilities including supported languages/regions, device brands, system types, RTL language detection, temperature conversion, timezone formatting, and regional device mapping.
frontend/src/lib/weather.ts: Integrates Open-Meteo API for weather data fetching with weather code mapping, geolocation support, and returns current conditions plus hourly forecast.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication context.
frontend/src/pages/BestPracticesPage.tsx: Displays a comprehensive best practices guide with sections on connection maintenance, troubleshooting, and performance optimization using accordions and cards. Includes weekly, monthly, and quarterly maintenance schedules with visual icons and badges.
frontend/src/pages/ComplianceSecurityPag: Renders a compliance and security documentation page with print/PDF download functionality, including custom print styles and a fixed download button. Uses cards, badges, and separators to display security policies and compliance information.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard page with tabbed interface showing Overview, Systems, Alarms, Recommendations, Analytics, and Maintenance tabs. Includes admin-only navigation buttons for Domains, Email, and Deployment Status pages.
Admin page for monitoring ICP Gateway domain configuration and deployment status for ecopowerhub.ai domains. Includes domain accessibility checks, SSL validation, and displays configuration instructions with copy-to-clipboard functionality.
frontend/src/pages/DeviceIntegrationGuid: Displays detailed integration guides for various energy monitoring devices (Emporia Vue models) with setup steps, troubleshooting, privacy notes, and EcoToken benefits. Uses collapsible sections and device-specific configuration data.
frontend/src/pages/DiagnosticsPage.tsx: Diagnostics page displaying continental electrical system specifications (voltage, frequency, plug types) and documentation links for Emporia Vue installation guides. Includes search/filter functionality and a SmartDiagnosticsPanel component.
frontend/src/pages/DomainPortfolioPage.t: Domain portfolio strategy page showing mock data for EcoPowerHub domain variants (.com, .net, .org, .ai, etc.) with availability status, pricing, and brand protection recommendations. Backend implementation pending.
frontend/src/pages/EmailAutomationPage.t: Email automation rules page with keyword-triggered responses for common support queries (Emporia connection, device integration, billing, security). Features founder-voice style sharp, concise responses with toggleable automation rules.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Marketing landing page with full-screen hero section featuring globe background, CTA button, device setup guides section, and marketing header/footer components. Promotes global smart energy optimization platform.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Internet Identity login page with feature highlights (real-time tracking, global compatibility, smart recommendations, security). Handles authentication flow and redirects to dashboard upon successful login.
frontend/src/pages/MarketingCampaignAsse: Displays marketing campaign assets including a 60-second video ad script with scene breakdowns, banner variants for different platforms, and copy-to-clipboard functionality for easy sharing.
frontend/src/pages/PartnerMarketplacePag: Showcases affiliate programs for energy monitoring devices (Sense, Emporia, Amazon Associates, ShareASale, CJ Affiliate) with commission rates, tracking IDs, and benefits for monetizing energy optimization expertise.
frontend/src/pages/PrivacyPolicyPage.tsx: Renders the privacy policy for Eco PowerHub AI LLC, detailing information collection, usage, sharing practices, data security measures, and user rights regarding personal and energy consumption data.
frontend/src/pages/SupportIntegrationsPa: Displays support boundaries and manufacturer integrations using React Query hooks, showing what the platform supports versus manufacturer responsibilities with loading and error handling.
frontend/src/pages/TechSpecsPage.tsx: Presents technical specifications including global voltage compatibility matrix, device specs for various energy monitors (Sense, Emporia, Shelly, etc.), compliance standards, and SCADA protocol support.
frontend/src/routes/RootRoute.tsx: Root route component that renders the Outlet for nested routes in the TanStack Router configuration.
frontend/src/types/index.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces for the frontend application, including system configurations, energy data, recommendations, alarms, EV telemetry, pricing models, SCADA protocols, case studies, and maintenance events.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters and session storage, supporting both standard query strings and hash-based routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind CSS with custom color schemes using OKLCH color space, extended animations, container settings, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
frontend/vite-build-verify.js: Verifies that required PNG image assets (logos, setup guides, case studies) with specific dimensions are present in the build output after Vite compilation.
frontend/vite.config.ts: Configures Vite build tool with React plugin, code splitting strategy for vendor chunks (React, TanStack, Radix UI, charts, 3D libraries), path aliases, and development server proxy settings.
project_state.json: Tracks project state for EcoPowerHub AI, documenting known Motoko syntax errors in gateway/main.mo and canister deployment failures that need to be resolved.
